message:
Running command: cd /workspace && cat > candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "tests/internal/fuzzers/parser_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 63, "var": "data[0]", "code": "if (GET_MOD_EQ(4,0)) { format = \"json\"; }", "note": "Attacker-controlled first byte selects format 'json', a valid format so flb_parser_create passes the format check."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "tests/internal/fuzzers/parser_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 72, "var": "time_fmt", "code": "if (GET_MOD_EQ(2,1)) { time_fmt = get_null_terminated(15, &data, &size); }", "note": "time_fmt is set from attacker bytes, enabling the timezone-offset code path inside flb_parser_create."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "tests/internal/fuzzers/parser_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 80, "var": "time_offset", "code": "if (GET_MOD_EQ(2,1)) { time_offset = get_null_terminated(15, &data, &size); }", "note": "time_offset is set; its first byte is 'C' (not 'Z','+','-'), so flb_parser_tzone_offset will reject it."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "tests/internal/fuzzers/parser_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 96, "var": "list", "code": "if (GET_MOD_EQ(2,1)) { ... list = flb_malloc(...); mk_list_add(&dec->_head, list); ... }", "note": "A decoder list is allocated and populated with a dec context and rules; this list is assigned to p->decoders inside flb_parser_create."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "tests/internal/fuzzers/parser_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 116, "var": "fuzz_parser", "code": "fuzz_parser = flb_parser_create(\"fuzzer\", format, pregex, time_fmt, time_key, time_offset, time_keep, types, types_len, list, fuzz_config);", "note": "flb_parser_create sets p->decoders = list and adds p to config->parsers, then reaches the time_offset validation."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "src/flb_parser.c", "function": "flb_parser_create", "line": 260, "var": "ret", "code": "ret = flb_parser_tzone_offset(time_offset, len, &diff); if (ret == -1) { flb_parser_destroy(p); return NULL; }", "note": "Invalid time_offset makes flb_parser_tzone_offset return -1, so flb_parser_destroy(p) is invoked, which frees the decoder list via flb_parser_decoder_list_destroy(p->decoders)."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "src/flb_parser.c", "function": "flb_parser_destroy", "line": 300, "var": "parser->decoders", "code": "if (parser->decoders) { flb_parser_decoder_list_destroy(parser->decoders); }", "note": "The decoder list (same pointer as 'list' in the fuzzer) is freed here; flb_parser_create returns NULL."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "tests/internal/fuzzers/parser_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 137, "var": "list", "code": "else { if (list != NULL) { flb_parser_decoder_list_destroy(list); } }", "note": "Because flb_parser_create returned NULL, the fuzzer calls flb_parser_decoder_list_destroy(list) on the already-freed decoder list, causing a double free."},
  {"step": 9, "file": "src/flb_parser_decoder.c", "function": "flb_parser_decoder_list_destroy", "line": 470, "var": "dec_rule", "code": "flb_free(dec_rule);", "note": "flb_free reads the freed allocation's metadata (8 bytes) to determine its size, triggering the heap-use-after-free READ 8."}
]
EOF
echo "trace written"; python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')); print('valid json')"
